messages:
maya: Kicking off mid-roll for model-route v3. Plan: ramp feature toggle `route_v3` to 30% -> 60% -> 100% (10m / 15m / final), with a venting step for noisy cohorts. Deploybot please start at the scheduled window. We'll pin runtime image v3.2.1 for the rollout.
ben: ack. I'll monitor p95 latency and 5xx rate. My quick rollback thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 increase > 150ms vs baseline for 5m -> snapback to previous toggle state (0%).
priya: I'm on logs + traces. If we see user-facing errors, I'll add a temporary cohort quarantine to 0% and collect traces. Leave the current session-sticky flag alone (we don't want to drop existing sessions).
sre-oncall: setting a temporary alert: route_v3_error_rate_high -> alert if 5xx > 0.4% for 4m AND deploy duration >= 6m. I'll put the oncall watch in the dashboard.
deploy-bot: queued job created by maya for `route_v3` toggle. Targets: services {api-gateway, inference-router, routing-proxy}. Rolling change will be done from us-east-1 then eu-west-1. Expected job id: db-6612345678.
maya: NOTE: Venting detail = when we see error spike from a cohort, we reduce that cohort slice by 50% immediately (not full disable) to avoid cascade, then evaluate. If error persists, full snapback.
ben: can we add a canary tag for a small traffic slice (0.1%) that gets heavier sampling for logs/metrics? would help debug if noise appears.
priya: yes, use cohort `debug-microcanary` 0.1% with forced trace sampling. I'll prepare the Kibana query and share a link when ready.
maya: manual commands if we need to revert fast: 
```
# set toggle to 0% (full rollback)
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/route_v3 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"percentage":0, "reason":"emergency-snapback"}'

# partial venting for cohort id 42
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/route_v3/cohorts/42 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"percentage":15}'
```
sre-oncall: adding an automated quick rollback runbook for the channel: if deploy-bot reports job failure OR custom-alert fires, first step is to run the curl above, second step tag the incident channel, third step run `deploy-bot drain db-6612345678` to stop further progression.
deploy-bot: job db-6612345678: started toggle -> 30% at 6612345686. Canary slice `debug-microcanary` enabled at 0.1%. Rolling to us-east-1 (stage 1).
ben: watching metrics now. baseline p95 220ms, baseline 5xx 0.08%.
priya: kibana saved query: https://kbn.redwood/s/route_v3-debug?saved=query123 (captures sampled traces).
maya: reminder: do not unpin the runtime image during this mid-roll; pinning v3.2.1 is intentional because later canaries depend on a KV-cache behavior fix.
ben: at +7m p95 moved to 240ms (up 20ms), 5xx at 0.12% — still within tolerance. continuing.
priya: found a small spike in auth-timeouts from a single upstream host; quarantining that cohort via cohort id 27 to 10%.
maya: good — vent cohort 27 to 10% and increase sample logging for it.
deploy-bot: cohort 27 vented to 10%.
sre-oncall: momentary alert fired (route_v3_error_rate_high) but cleared after cohort venting. No action required.
ben: metrics look stable across the second region. proceeding to 60% after the 10m window.
maya: proceeding with next ramp. deploy-bot, advance to 60% when ready.
deploy-bot: job db-6612345678: advanced toggle -> 60% at 6612345698. Rolling eu-west-1 stage.
priya: observed an uptick in p95 in eu-west-1 only; digging into traces now. If it crosses 150ms delta for 5m, we'll do an immediate rollback.
ben: eu-west p95 delta currently 170ms over baseline and sustained 4m, 5xx at 0.45%. This is borderline.
maya: decision: hold the ramp. Do not go to 100%. Priya, continue trace collection. Ben, keep the venting plan ready. If we hit 5xx > 0.5% for another minute, run the emergency snapback command.
priya: confirmed trace points to a router desync on a subset of instances (old kernel). Opening infra task to cordon those nodes.
sre-oncall: cordon request submitted to infra. If nodes cannot be cordoned in 3m, we'll revert to 0% and create a postmortem.
ben: agreed. I'll prepare the rollback note for release notes if we snap back: include steps, job id, cohorts affected, and timing.
maya: thank you everyone — holding here. I'll update channel as soon as infra confirms node cordon.
priya: infra cordon completed, rerouting traffic away from bad nodes. p95 in eu-west trending back to baseline.
b en: eu-west p95 now 235ms (down 40ms), 5xx 0.12%. safe to continue to 100% after we let it stabilize 5m.
maya: ok advance to full. deploy-bot, finish rollout to 100% and mark job db-6612345678 complete.
deploy-bot: job db-6612345678: advanced -> 100% at 6612345700. Rollout complete.
maya: post-deploy checklist: 1) unpin temporary microcanary, 2) remove extra trace sampling, 3) set alert sensitivity back to normal, 4) update release notes with cohorts vented and infra remediation. Ben & Priya please handle 1-3.
ben: will update release notes and add rollback appendix.
priya: will remove trace sampling and close the debug query.
maya: thanks all. Closing thread — filing a short blameless note for the infra kernel drift and the cohort venting saved the rollout. :tada:
